title: Fusion barrier for c62's Flow-Lenia predators: an annular predator-predator repulsion kernel (zero gradient on a round body's own centre, pushes neighbours and fresh daughters apart)
summary: Add to the predator velocity -c_rep grad(K_ring * B), K_ring a ring beyond the body radius; screen c_rep on the S-claim world for predator merge/split, persistent splits and generation, keeping the prey effect.
